# ZomboidControl

A web control panel for **Project Zomboid** dedicated servers (build 42).
Symfony 7 API plus a React single-page application, deployed as one Docker
image or on Coolify.

The panel reaches a game server only over **FTP/SFTP** and **RCON**, plus a
Lua mod it uploads itself ("the bridge") that writes state files the panel
reads back. It never runs beside the game, which rules some features out —
see *Constraints* below.

## Read these first

- `CLAUDE.md` — the binding conventions. Read before changing anything.
- `CONTEXT.md` — the running record: what is built, what is verified, what
  is known broken, what comes next. After a context compaction it is the
  only thing that carries state forward.
- `docs/superpowers/briefs/` — what each sub-project is for and why.
- `docs/superpowers/specs/` — designs, with the evidence behind each choice.
- `docs/superpowers/plans/` — steps, with real progress marked.

## Layout

```
backend/          Symfony 7, PHP 8.4 — 169 files
  src/Controller/Api/     the HTTP surface, one controller per area
  src/Entity/             Doctrine entities
  src/Server/             everything that talks to a game server
    Bridge/               the Lua mod's command queue and readers
    Rcon/                 the RCON client and command catalogue
    Storage/              FTP/SFTP browsing, reading and uploading
    Players/ Items/ Events/ Vehicles/ Logs/ Chat/
  src/Security/           auth, permissions, encryption, OAuth
  src/Panel/              the panel's own version and update check
  resources/bridge/       ZomboidControlBridge.lua, uploaded to the server
  tests/                  PHPUnit; tests/Bridge/*.lua run under lua5.1

frontend/         React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind 4, shadcn/ui
  src/features/<area>/    one directory per area, matching the backend
  src/components/ui/      shadcn primitives, unmodified where possible
  src/components/layout/  sidebar, top bar, breadcrumbs
  src/i18n/locales/       de.json and en.json — the only German in the repo
  src/routes/             router, guards, lazy loading
```

## How it fits together

1. **RCON** for anything the game exposes as an admin command: kick, ban,
   teleport, weather, spawning, `servermsg`. `EventDispatcher::commandFor()`
   builds the exact command strings; they are pinned by tests because a
   wrong argument shape fails silently in-game.
2. **The bridge** for everything RCON has no command for: the in-game clock,
   climate values, sounds at a point, reading player state. The panel writes
   `cmd-<seq>.json` over FTP, the mod answers `res-<seq>.json`, each side
   owning its own cursor.
3. **Save files** for what neither offers: `vehicles.db` is read directly
   (a SQLite copy pulled over FTP) so every vehicle on the map is known even
   with no player nearby.

## Constraints worth knowing before proposing a feature

- **Remote only.** No host CPU, RAM or disk metrics: the panel would be
  measuring its own container, not the game server.
- **Shutdown is one-way.** RCON `quit` stops a server; nothing can start a
  stopped one. A restart is honest only where the host restarts by itself.
- **The bridge version matters.** Handlers added to the Lua only work once
  the file is uploaded *and* the game server restarted.
- **Game artwork stays out of git.** Vehicle models and item textures are
  The Indie Stone's; they are uploaded by the operator into `backend/var/`,
  which is gitignored.

## Conventions that are not negotiable

- **All code, comments, tests, commits and docs are English.** German lives
  only in `frontend/src/i18n/locales/de.json`.
- **No prose comments.** Reasoning goes in `CONTEXT.md` or into a test name
  that states the rule. Short single lines marking a non-obvious constraint
  are fine.
- **Secrets: encrypted versus hashed is not interchangeable.** FTP, RCON and
  TOTP secrets must be readable again, so they are encrypted. Passwords,
  backup codes and invitation tokens are hashed.
- **Verified means demonstrated.** Backend work gets a test; interface work
  gets checked in a real browser. Say plainly what was checked and what was
  not.

## Commands

Everything runs inside ddev; PHP, Composer and the right Node binaries do
not exist on the host.

| Task | Command |
|---|---|
| Start | `ddev start` |
| Frontend with hot reload | `ddev dev` |
| Backend tests | `ddev exec -d /var/www/html/backend "php bin/phpunit"` |
| Frontend tests | `ddev exec -d /var/www/html/frontend "npm run test"` |
| Linter | `ddev exec -d /var/www/html/frontend "npm run lint"` |
| Build | `ddev exec -d /var/www/html/frontend "npm run build"` |
| Bridge syntax | `ddev exec "luac5.1 -p backend/resources/bridge/ZomboidControlBridge.lua"` |

## Testing habits particular to this project

- **Cross-language guards.** The Lua bridge is tested in Lua, because Lua is
  what runs on the game server. The Lua test carries a copy of the functions
  under test and a PHPUnit test asserts the copy has not drifted — see
  `BridgeDecoderTest` and `BridgeVehicleListTest`.
- **Source-reading tests.** Some frontend tests read a source file with
  `readFileSync` and assert a table against it, rather than rendering
  components; there is no rendering stack in this frontend.
- **Catalogue walks.** Tests iterate whole catalogues (every RCON action,
  every vehicle) so a new entry cannot be added without its wiring.
